name: The Kiprun Singapore 2026
short_description: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 was planned as a half marathon on 27 September 2026 in Kallang, Singapore, but haze led the organisers to cut the 21.1 km to 10 km on race morning, The Straits Times reported.
ai_summary: The Kiprun Singapore 2026, the first edition, was held on Sunday 27 September 2026, organised by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, starting on Nicoll Highway and finishing at the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang. Categories were a 21.1 km half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and a 670 m Kids Dash. The Straits Times reported that, with 24-hour PSI readings in the unhealthy range, the half marathon was shortened to 10 km, the awards ceremony was cancelled and all categories became non-competitive; the other distances were unchanged.

core_facts.venue: Nicoll Highway (start) to Decathlon Singapore Lab, Kallang (finish)

pros: Written haze plan with thresholds set in advance; runners told of changes by about 3am
Shuttle buses from 20 MRT stations for the pre-dawn start
Eight aid stations planned on the half marathon, with an energy gel at 12.2 km
Nicoll Highway closed to traffic from 1am to 9am for the start
Timed results with splits published despite the non-competitive format
cons: The 2026 half marathon was cut to 10 km by haze; the full course has never been raced
No refund or credit for the shortened half marathon; fees are non-refundable under the terms
Parts of the planned half-marathon route had only lane closures
Trains do not run before the start; a shuttle or taxi is needed
research_highlights: This was the inaugural edition of The Kiprun Singapore, organised by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, held on 27 September 2026; Decathlon previously organised the Decathlon Run, last held in 2022.
Four race categories were offered: a 21.1km Half Marathon, 10km Run, 5km Run and a 670m Kids Dash.

The 21.1km, 10km and 5km races started on Nicoll Highway, with a pre-start area on Mountbatten Road, and finished at the Decathlon Singapore Lab near the National Stadium in Kallang, where the festival village was.
Super Early Bird prices started from S$78 for the Half Marathon, S$60 for the 10km and S$10 for the Kids Dash, before GST.

The planned 21.1km route took in Sheares Avenue, Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay and Marina Barrage, with aid stations roughly every 2.5km; those sections were dropped when the half marathon was cut to a 10km loop because of haze.
research_watchouts: On race morning the organisers cut the 21.1km to 10km after air-quality readings at 2am exceeded their action thresholds, and cancelled all rankings and the awards ceremony, according to The Straits Times.

The race terms, as checked by The Straits Times, say registration fees are not refunded if the event is changed or cancelled unless the organisers state otherwise; no compensation for half-marathon entrants had been announced when Mothership and SportPlus reported.

Haze was already a concern in race week: SportPlus reported that the organisers posted air-quality advisories at race-pack collection on 19 September, saying they were monitoring NEA's 24-hour PSI and 1-hour PM2.5 readings.

faqs.question: When is The Kiprun Singapore 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: It was held on Sunday 27 September 2026, the first edition. Start times stayed as planned, with half-marathon waves from 5.10am, the 10 km at 6am and the 5 km from 7.25am, but the organisers announced at about 3am that the half marathon would be shortened to 10 km because of haze.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: Four categories: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km and a 670 m Kids Dash. In 2026 the half marathon was cut to 10 km on race morning because of haze, while the other distances were unchanged, and all categories became non-competitive with the awards ceremony cancelled.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km started on Nicoll Highway, with runners entering the start pens from a pre-start area on Mountbatten Road, and finished at the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang, where the festival village was. The Kids Dash started at Stadium Crescent. The nearest MRT station is Mountbatten.

faqs.question: Who organizes The Kiprun Singapore 2026?
faqs.answer: MetaSport organises The Kiprun Singapore, and Decathlon Singapore presents it and co-organises. The two made the call to shorten the 2026 half marathon because of haze, citing their event contingency plans and SportSG and National Environment Agency guidance, and told participants by social media, email and text message.
